blind.description: A stylized six-panel wooden door leaf with a golden doorknob and escutcheon plate on one side. The panels are slightly recessed with beveled wooden framing. The surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled in a hand-painted/cartoon aesthetic with warm brown wood tones and brass/gold hardware.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal rectangle with slightly rounded corners, showing the top edge of the wooden door and small rounded bumps on either side for the doorknobs.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the figure, roughly 6.5 to 7 feet tall, and about 3 feet wide.
